name: WM (Waste Management)
why: Largest US hauler (~21M customers, rank 1); national My WM portal.

name: Republic Services
why: Second-largest US hauler (~13M customers, rank 2); national online account and one-time payment.

name: Waste Connections
why: Third-largest (~9M customers, rank 3); national MyAccount portal.

name: GFL Environmental
why: 4M+ households (rank 4), absorbed WCA; national GFL MyAccount with documented AutoPay timing options.

name: Waste Pro USA
why: 2.5M+ residential customers in the Southeast (rank 5); division-based online bill pay portal.

name: Recology
why: ~1.1M customers in CA/OR/WA (rank 6); new Customer Account Portal with documented autopay and paperless.

name: Casella Waste Systems
why: 1M+ customers in the Northeast (rank 7); Kubra portal with published card fee.

name: Rumpke Waste & Recycling
why: Major Ohio Valley hauler (~1M billing customers, rank 8); RumpkePay (Kubra) with documented $2.95 fee.

name: Amwaste
why: ~500k customers in AL/LA (Georgia operations suspended Jan 2025) (rank 45, among the largest remaining private haulers); InvoiceCloud portal with documented fees and help center. Chosen over Republic Southern Nevada (same Republic billing site), LA Sanitation (billed on LADWP bill), CR&R and Burrtec (no public billing documentation).

name: Athens Services
why: Large Southern California hauler (~250k, rank 51) with a fully documented Web-Pak online bill pay FAQ; picked over larger-ranked but undocumented or duplicate records.

name: CR&R Environmental Services
why: ~1M households in CA/AZ (rank 12, largest unclaimed private hauler); Soft-Pak Web-Pak online bill pay with documented recurring-payment rules.

name: Burrtec Waste Industries
why: ~500k customers in Southern California; RevSpring/Evoke bill-pay portal with no-login payment by customer number and ZIP, AutoPay and a fee-waiver program.

name: WIN Waste Innovations
why: Large Northeast/Mid-Atlantic hauler (~300k residential); My Account sign-in, one-time payment by account number and ZIP, published manual-payment fee rule.

name: LRS (Lakeshore Recycling Systems)
why: ~400k customers in IL/WI/IN and the Southeast; Pay My Bill routed by ZIP, paperless sign-up and new customer portal with Google sign-in.

name: Meridian Waste Solutions
why: ~300k customers across 8 states; Soft-Pak Web-Pak online bill pay with published FAQ.

name: Interstate Waste Services (IWS)
why: ~250k customers in NY/NJ/CT incl. Action Carting; MyIWS portal with Quick Pay, AutoPay and pay-by-phone documented in FAQ.

name: Texas Disposal Systems
why: Largest independent Texas hauler (Austin/San Antonio); Web-Pak bill pay with documented AutoPay access code. Chosen over Coastal Waste (no central billing phone, mostly commercial).

name: Priority Waste
why: Largest Michigan independent hauler (absorbed former GFL Michigan communities); AMCS portal, no-sign-in card/ACH payments, documented Auto Pay steps.

name: Denver Solid Waste Management
why: ~180k households (rank 29) billed directly by the City and County of Denver for solid waste service; Denver Utilities Online for pay, AutoPay and paperless. Higher-ranked municipal records are billed on water/property-tax bills or duplicate existing dossiers (Chicago Utility Billing).

name: Miami-Dade County Department of Solid Waste Management
why: ~350k households (rank 15); its own Solid Waste Online Payment System (card only, no convenience fee, pay without signing in).
